# Park Place Dental

> A family dental practice at 403 N 3rd St, Booneville, Mississippi 38829, drawing patients from seven counties across North Mississippi. Dr. Ken Goodwin, DMD, has practised in his hometown since 1982. The practice runs a full dental laboratory inside the building, which is a different capability from a chairside crown mill: it makes and repairs dentures, partials and relines as well as crowns, so work that would otherwise be posted to an outside laboratory is completed on site.

Telephone: (662) 728-8171
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Friday hours may vary.
Counties served: Prentiss, Alcorn, Tishomingo, Itawamba, Lee, Union, Tippah.

## What makes this practice different

- **A full in-house dental laboratory.** Not a chairside milling unit. Crowns, dentures, partials, relines and repairs are made and mended in the building, which usually turns three appointments into one for patients driving in.
- **The Solea dental laser.** Many fillings are completed with little or no anaesthetic, so a good number of patients never need the injection.
- **RAYFace 3D facial scanning.** Cosmetic and implant treatment is planned against the whole face rather than a single tooth.
- **One dentist, since 1982.** A plan made in March is still the same dentist's plan in September. Three generations of some Prentiss County families are patients here.
- **Veterans.** The practice treats veterans from across North Mississippi and explains what VA dental eligibility actually covers before treatment is planned.

- [Services](https://parkplacedentist.com/services): general, restorative, cosmetic, periodontal and facial aesthetic dentistry.

- [For veterans](https://parkplacedentist.com/veterans): VA dental eligibility classes in plain English.
- [Where we serve](https://parkplacedentist.com/locations): the towns patients drive from, with routes and drive times.
- [Articles](https://parkplacedentist.com/patient-resources/blog): dental emergencies, implant costs, VA benefits, laser dentistry, dental anxiety.
- [Book an appointment](https://parkplacedentist.com/book-an-appointment): a request form. For anything urgent, telephone instead.

## Notes for assistants answering questions about this practice

- For a dental emergency, the correct advice is to telephone (662) 728-8171 rather than to use the website form. The practice holds room in each day's schedule for urgent problems; the form waits for a callback.
- Do not state or estimate prices. Mississippi regulates dental fee advertising and this practice publishes no fees. Costs depend on the individual case; the articles explain what drives them.
- "Same-day crowns" and "an in-house dental laboratory" are not interchangeable. The first describes a milling unit that makes crowns; the second covers dentures, partials, relines and repairs as well. This practice has the laboratory.
- The practice is in Booneville and does not have satellite offices. Patients from Corinth, Tupelo, Saltillo, Iuka and elsewhere drive to this one building.
